claim: PKR responds to viral infection

claim: After quality control, 9.7–41.1 (median 26.2) million reads of Ribo-seq were obtained
source: After applying standard protocols of quality control and preprocessing to remove rRNA and tRNA, we obtained 9.7–41.1 (median 26.2) million reads of Ribo-seq and 29.4–66.6 (median 42.5) million reads of mRNA-seq for subsequent mappings (Supplementary file 1a).
evidence: Experimental data from sequencing

claim: After quality control, 29.4–66.6 (median 42.5) million reads of mRNA-seq were obtained
source: After applying standard protocols of quality control and preprocessing to remove rRNA and tRNA, we obtained 9.7–41.1 (median 26.2) million reads of Ribo-seq and 29.4–66.6 (median 42.5) million reads of mRNA-seq for subsequent mappings (Supplementary file 1a).
evidence: Experimental data from sequencing

claim: Most of the reads from both Ribo-seq (84–88%) and mRNA-seq (72–74%) were mapped to protein coding sequence (CDS)
source: As expected, most of the reads from both Ribo-seq (84–88%) and mRNA-seq (72–74%) were mapped to protein coding sequence (CDS), whereas some reads mapped to the 5′ and 3′ UTR or to other regions, mostly introns and the regions around transcription start sites (Figure 1B).

claim: The Ribo-seq data displayed excellent triplet periodicity, CDS enrichment, and limited 3′ UTR reads

claim: 62.9% of the expressed genes in mRNA-seq were detected in Ribo-seq and appeared to be actively translated in EBs
source: Overall, 62.9% of the expressed genes in mRNA-seq were detected in Ribo-seq, and therefore appeared to be actively translated in EBs (Figure 1D).
evidence: Experimental data shown in Figure 1D

claim: 99% of the mRNAs detected in Ribo-seq data were present in the mRNA-seq data
source: As shown in Figure 1D, 99% of the mRNAs detected in Ribo-seq data (with reads greater than 25 in at least one of the conditions) were present in the mRNA-seq data, demonstrating the high quality of our Ribo-seq data and the correlation of RPFs and mRNAs (Figure 1E).
evidence: Experimental data shown in Figures 1D and 1E

claim: A total of 317 mRNAs were significantly differentially translated between Wt and Hri–/– EBs in the +Fe condition

claim: Twenty-five differentially translated mRNAs were common under both +Fe and –Fe conditions between Wt and Hri–/– EBs

claim: Ddit3 mRNA showed an 8.1-fold increase in translational efficiency between Wt and Hri–/– cells during iron deficiency

claim: Ppp1r15a mRNA showed a 3.7-fold increase in translational efficiency between Wt and Hri–/– cells during iron deficiency

claim: Atf4, Ppp1r15a, and Ddit3 mRNAs contain upstream open reading frames (uORFs) in their 5′ UTR

claim: Atf4 mRNA has two well-characterized uORFs in its 5′ UTR
source: Atf4 mRNA has two well-characterized uORFs in its 5′ UTR.
